title: Ultimate Roasted Russian Sea Bass Grill
description: A roasted, juicy, indulgent Russian dish featuring sea bass fillets, yakimono-grill, and ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly ingredients, this recipe is perfect for a special occasion dinner.
instructions: Preheat the yakimono-grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Rinse the sea bass fillets under cold water and pat them dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, chopped fresh dill, minced garlic, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Place the sea bass fillets in a shallow dish and brush the mixture evenly over both sides of the fillets.
Place the fillets on the preheated yakimono-grill and roast for 12 minutes per side.
Remove the fillets from the grill and let them rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the roasted sea bass fillets hot, garnished with additional chopped fresh dill if desired.
